{"loc":"TABATABAI:5:55-56#3","rows":[{"verses":["5:55","5:56"],"words":["وَرَسُولُهُۥ"],"type":"interpretation","speaker":"author","stance":"rejects","claim":"It is improper to call the Prophet a supporter of believers in the relevant religious sense; support is rendered to God's religion, which God legislates and the Messenger and believers uphold.","anchor":"على أنه ليس من الجائز أن يعد النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم وليا للمؤمنين بمعنى ولاية النصرة","mentions":["61:14","47:7","3:81"]},{"verses":["5:55"],"words":["ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟"],"type":"links","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"The Qur'an calls the disciples helpers of God and describes support for God's cause and covenant with prophets to believe in and support the coming messenger.","anchor":"قال الحواريون نحن أنصار الله","mentions":["61:14","47:7","3:81"]},{"verses":["5:55"],"words":["وَرَسُولُهُۥ"],"type":"links","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"The Qur'an also praises the Prophet's supporters, those who aid God's Messenger, and the Helpers who sheltered and supported the emigrants.","anchor":"وعزروه ونصروه","mentions":["7:157","59:8","8:72"]},{"verses":["5:55","5:56"],"words":["ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟"],"type":"links","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"Since believers are bound to God's religious law, the Qur'an describes God as supporting those who support Him and as supporting His messengers and believers.","anchor":"ولينصرن الله من ينصره","mentions":["22:40","40:51","30:47"]},{"verses":["5:55","5:56"],"words":["*"],"type":"interpretation","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"Religion cannot belong only to believers with the Prophet outside it and then make him their supporter: he shares every religious distinction in its fullest measure, and the Qur'an never calls him their supporter.","anchor":"ولا في آية واحدة، وحاشا ساحة الكلام الإلهي أن يساهل","mentions":[]}]}
